name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODE::process_atom
comment: Pin direction = one arch-group mux, 7 values: 0 in, 1 out, 2 out+OE, 3 open-drain, 4 od+OE, 5 registered OE, 6 registered-OE od. Selected via ASM_ARCH_GROUP::mux_select(group, io_index, value). Group type name: IO_PIN_MODE (asmdb group-type enum 84).

name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODE::handle_ygr_dual_pin_iost
comment: IO standard as mux 0/1: standard class 0x37.. / 0x47.. / 0x48.. plus atom bit 4.

name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODEL::process_atom
comment: Per-pin model entry; resolves pin index for the arch groups.

name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODEL::init_pin_modes_from_chip
comment: Builds per-pin mode table from CDB_CHIP_DB_ENTRY (pad info from ddb pad file).

name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODEL::construct_gid_to_pin_index_map
comment: gid -> pin index map; uses dirt index cache type 0x17 (INDEX_CACHE).

name: ASM_IO_PIN_MODEL_YGR::ASM_IO_PIN_MODEL_YGR
comment: Pin model ctor takes (CDB_CHIP_DB_ENTRY, DEV_DIE_INFO, DEV_PAD_INFO): pad -> pin data comes from the pad ddb (DEV_PAD_INFO), not from the pkg file.

name: asm_convert_db_to_asm_iost
comment: DEV_IO_STANDARD_ENUM -> asm IOST class 0..12.

name: ASM_IO_USE_BUS_HOLD::process_atom
comment: Boolean mux in group IO_USE_BUS_HOLD (asmdb group-type enum 165): mux_select(group, resolve_io_index_for_block(), cut_io_util->vtbl+0x78(atom)). Index -1 = no pin.

name: ASM_IO_USE_PULL_UP::process_atom
comment: Boolean mux in group IO_USE_PULL_UP (enum 178): value = cut_io_util->vtbl+0x88(atom).

name: ASM_IO_USE_SLOW_SLEW::process_atom
comment: Boolean mux in group IO_USE_SLOW_SLEW (enum 180): value = atom vtbl+0xe58.

name: ASM_IO_USE_OPEN_DRAIN::process_atom
comment: Boolean mux in group IO_USE_OPEN_DRAIN (enum 182): value = asm_test_atom_bit(atom, 0x16); index from ASM_MODEL::s_io_index.

name: ASM_IO_SET_DRIVE_STRENGTH_YGR::process_atom
comment: Drive strength: value from get_settings(io_standard, current_strength, vio/hio pad, ..) then mux_select; group IO_SET_DRIVE_STRENGTH_YGR (enum 161). Other families: _TORNADO 162, _ARMSTRONG 163, _TSUNAMI 164.

name: ASM_IO_SET_DRIVE_STRENGTH_YGR::get_settings
comment: Walks the global dirt tree: IO -> IO_SET_DRIVE_STRENGTH_YGR -> IO_STANDARD(str) -> CURRENT_STRENGTH(str) -> VIO_PAD|HIO_PAD -> SETTINGS (int = mux value). Dirt type ids: IO 0x99, group 0x69, IO_STANDARD 0x19, CURRENT_STRENGTH 0xa8, VIO_PAD 0xa5, HIO_PAD 0xa6, SETTINGS 0x18. Cyclone IV stingray dirt ddb has no IO subtree.

name: ASM_IO_SELECT_IOST_DIRT::get_settings
comment: IO standard setting lookup in the dirt tree by DEV_IO_STANDARD_ENUM.

name: ASM_BITFIELD::silent_set_bits
comment: Address-space tags: CRAM bit31 clear; CFF 101 top; UNVM 1001; OPTION 10001; DPRIO 100001; literals 11; DB_ILLEGAL_* = 0xfffffffa..e. See io.ADDRESS_SPACES.

name: ASM_ARCH_GROUP::resolve_io_index_for_block
comment: Returns the IO index of the current atom's pin for this group's block type; 0xffffffff = none.

name: ASM_ARCH_GROUP::mux_select
comment: mux_select(group, io_or_instance_index, value, streams): writes the mux setting bits for one group instance into the ASMDB setting streams.

name: ASMDB_DIE::operator<<
comment: Field order and offsets are in structs.tsv (ASMDB_DIE). Root object of asmdb ddb: tag 4 then main stream; object pools follow (see libdb_pdb PDB_SEGMENT_READER::finish_reading_all).

name: ASMDB_BLOCK_INFO::operator<<
comment: Layout in structs.tsv (ASMDB_BLOCK_INFO, 0xc0 bytes per ddb type table).

name: asmdb_get_debug_string
comment: Block-type enum -> name via ASMDB_TRANSLATOR::m_asmdb_arch_group_block_type_debug_string_table.

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::xfr_ptr
comment: Pointer tag u32: 0 null; bit0 set = u16 adjust + u16 class idx follow; bit1 set = back-reference, id = (tag>>2) + last id of that static type; bit1 clear = NEW object of class tag>>2, appended to the static type's object list, type queued for finish_reading_all.

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::finish_reading_all
comment: Pool order: stack (LIFO) of static pointer types with pending objects; pop head, read ALL its pending objects in creation order (each by its dynamic class), nested new types are pushed and handled before earlier-queued ones. Dirt ddb: single global FIFO reproduces all 1642 nodes exactly.

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::xfr_int_delta
comment: Value = stream i32 + same field of the reference object (previous object of the pool / previous element), not a running sum within one object.

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::xfr_stl_ptr
comment: STL container of pointers (serializer slot +0x28).

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::xfr_new
comment: Allocate/register object; vtable slot index 0x28.

name: DEV_PIN::operator<<
comment: Fields: m_id +0, m_bool_data +8, m_int_data +0x18 (25 i32), m_string_data +0xe8 ([0] ball name, [1] function), m_vec_int_data +0x190, string hash, 5 enum-is-valid bool vectors +0x1f0.., m_pad_id_list +0x240 (last).

name: DEV_PKG_INFO_BODY::operator<<
comment: Root of pkg ddb: vector<DEV_PIN*> (count + one ptr tag each) then hash<string, DEV_PKG_NET*>; type table has only DEV_PKG_INFO_BODY (1), DEV_PIN (896), std::string, so there is no second record kind.

name: PDB_SEGMENT_READER::xfr_stl_ptr
comment: Reads ONE presence byte (xfr_char); non-zero = STL container follows inline (not pooled). Used for BLOCK_INFO export / avalon maps and ASMDB_INDEX_MAP_WRAPPER.

name: ASMDB_BLOCK_INFO::operator<<
comment: Order: 3 strings, m_block_lists map<int, vector<uint>> (key, presence byte, vector), m_block_type, m_num_ram_cols (delta), m_simple_block_lists map<int,uint>, export map (presence byte + map<string,int>), avalon map (presence byte + map<int, address>), size map. IO blocks: type 5 HIO 131 sites, 6 VIO 325 sites (list length).

name: operator<<
comment: QTL_BOOL_VECTOR serializer: u32 nbits (xfr_int) then ceil(nbits/32) words, each xfr_int_delta against the previous word (first word against the previous object's first word).

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_CLKUSR::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 0 = NOT CDB_CHIP_DB_ENTRY::is_user_start_up_clock (QSF USER_START_UP_CLOCK ON -> 0). Dumb group OPTION_REG_USE_CLKUSR (enum 2365), address 0x88000000.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_RELEASE_CLEAR_BEFORE_TRI::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 2 = NOT ACF bool option 0x4c6 (RELEASE_CLEARS_BEFORE_TRI_STATES). Group enum 2368.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_ENABLE_AUTO_RECONFIGURE::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 6 = ACF bool option 0x4c7 (AUTO_RESTART_CONFIGURATION), direct polarity (dumb group arch byte 1); default ON. Group enum 2370.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_INITDONE::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 3 = NOT is_init_done (ENABLE_INIT_DONE_OUTPUT ON -> 0). Group enum 2369.

name: ASM_DEVICE_USE_GLOBAL_CLEAR::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 4 = NOT is_dev_clr (ENABLE_DEVICE_WIDE_RESET). Group DEVICE_USE_GLOBAL_CLEAR enum 2336.

name: ASM_DEVICE_USE_GLOBAL_TRI::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 5 = NOT is_dev_oe (ENABLE_DEVICE_WIDE_OE). Group DEVICE_USE_GLOBAL_TRI enum 2337.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_ERROR_DETECT::process_atom
comment: crcblock atom sets m_value 1 (or 2 for internal scrubbing); option bit 8 cleared when m_value or the QSF CRC option is on. Group enum 2371 = std group {bit 8; aux bit 92}.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_ERROR_DETECT::process_end_of_phase
comment: Writes the USE_ERROR_DETECT mux from m_value; bit 92 set only by the QSF CRC_ERROR_CHECKING option (pair crc_check_on vs crcblock_div1).

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_SELECT_CRC_FREQUENCY_DIVIDER::process_atom
comment: Reads the crcblock oscillator_divider via cga_interface param 0x32; all crcblock atoms must agree (internal error otherwise).

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_SELECT_CRC_FREQUENCY_DIVIDER::process_end_of_phase
comment: get_settings(divisor) -> option bits 27..34, one-hot: divisor 2^k sets bit 26+k, divisor 1 = zero (pairs crcblock_div1..256).

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_SELECT_SPI_PIN_STATE::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bits 9,10 = 2-bit SPI pin state: programming mode PS/FPP etc 3; active serial flash mode 1 -> 2; flash mode 0 -> NOT is_tri_state_spi_pins. Pairs scheme_ps (bit 9), spi_tristate_on (bit 10). Group enum 2372.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_SET_POF_ID::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bits 11..18 = 8-bit POF id, LSB first: DEV_PART_MANAGER::get_pof_id_of(part) (or an internal cfg override). 1 on all 9 IV GX sfl sofs. Group enum 2373.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_NCEO::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 91 = NOT (get_nceo_reserved_mode != 5); QSF CYCLONEII_RESERVE_NCEO_AFTER_CONFIGURATION 'USE AS REGULAR IO' -> 1. Group enum 2378.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_WAIT_FOR_OCTDONE::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bit 93 = NOT ACF bool option 0x4cd (ENABLE_OCT_DONE ON -> 0). Group enum 2379.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_EXTERNAL_CLK_SPI::process_end_of_phase
comment: Option bits 128,129 = ACF enum option 0x3ed (ACTIVE_SERIAL_CLOCK) through asmdb index map {262:3, 263:1, 264:0}: FREQ_20MHz 3, FREQ_40MHz 1 (default), CLKUSR 0. Group enum 2472.

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_JTAG_CORE_ACCESS::process_atom
comment: No asmdb group on the EP4CGX150 die (no option bit written).

name: ASM_OPTION_REG_USE_NCE::process_end_of_phase
comment: No asmdb group on the EP4CGX150 die (no option bit written); same for USE_JTAG_PIN_SHARE 1cb9c0, USE_NCONFIG 1cb934, ENABLE_PR, DEVICE_START_UP_CLOCK 1cb86e.

name: ASM_JTAG_WRITE_USER_CODE::process_end_of_phase
comment: No asmdb group on this die: USERCODE is written through ASM_BITFIELD::set_jtag_user_code to sof tag 19 (u32 at +12), not the option register.

name: ASM_JTAG_PIA_TO_TDOUSER::process_atom
comment: Std group JTAG_PIA_TO_TDOUSER (enum 523, block CONTROL): 16 CRAM bits (2 muxes 14 + 2); tdouser driven from the fabric sets 2 of them (4 builds).

name: ASM_JTAG_PIA_TO_TDOUTAP::process_atom
comment: Std group JTAG_PIA_TO_TDOUTAP (enum 524): 16 CRAM bits; the fitter rejects a driven tdoutap port on this die, 0 bits ever set.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_INFO_BODY::get_bits_from_source_to_dest
comment: Conduction bit list of edge (src,dst): bits of src's group for dst (value 1 if not use-encoded, else encoded_high), then every bit of dst's exclusion groups not already listed, value 0.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_INFO_BODY::check_routing_connection
comment: Verifier: use_encoded_setting of an exclusion group's first bit = 0 one-hot, 1 fully encoded, 2 inverted-encoded; asserts exactly the listed bits are set in each exclusion group.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_BIT::use_encoded_setting
comment: 0 if bit31 flag clear (one-hot); else 1 + byte4 bit1.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_BIT::is_encoded_bit_high
comment: Value of an encoded bit = byte4 bit0 (only valid when use_encoded_setting != 0).

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_BIT::operator<<
comment: Fields: 31-bit flat address delta, then 1-bit use-encoded (bit31), encoded-high, variant, address-space tag (0xA0000000) each as i8 delta vs previous bit object; on-disk b0/b1 flag bytes are deltas, value = running sum & 1.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_NODE::operator<<
comment: m_start_bit_index (u16 vector, group starts), m_asm_bits (flat bit vector).

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_NODE::setup_bit_groups
comment: Group order in a node: destination (fan-out) groups first, exclusion groups last.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_INFO_BODY::get_exclusion_bit_group
comment: Exclusion group i of node n = start index field of the node's route info + i.

name: DYGR_ROUTE_ASM_INFO_BODY::get_destination_bit_group
comment: Group index = position of dst in src's fan-out list (first_dest + offsets).

name: ASMDB_BLOCK_INFO::calculate_bits_traditional
comment: Used when both icd/bcm strings are empty (all IV GX BLOCK_INFOs). CRAM bit: (off / ram_cols + hi(list1[i])) * ram_cols + off % ram_cols + lo(list1[i]) = off + hi*ram_cols + lo; CFF-tagged (0xA0000000) bit: off + list3[i]; sentinel 0xC0000000 tags pass. Applied to calc groups only; std/dumb group bits are already absolute.

name: ASMDB_BLOCK_INFO::calculate_bits
comment: Dispatch: icd name empty -> traditional; else bcm address-space string empty -> bcm_style_absolute; else bcm_style_virtual.

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_io_arch_groups
comment: Factory: switch on ASMDB_ARCH_GROUP_TYPE (group+0xc), news the ASM_* processing class (vtable store). Case value = group type enum. Same shape: search_for_{le,lab,pll,oct,option_register,clockspine,cdr,hssi,dll,tsd,unvm,osc,adc}_arch_groups.

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_option_register_arch_groups
comment: Option-register factory; reproduces the group_type of all 13 pair-confirmed option groups (tests/cycloneiv_clean/test_hardblocks.py).

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_le_arch_groups
comment: LE factory (case 0xb = LE_USE_CARRY).

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_lab_arch_groups
comment: LAB factory.

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_pll_arch_groups
comment: PLL factory (74 PLL group types of this die bound).

name: ASM_ASMDBIO::search_for_clockspine_arch_groups
comment: Clock spine / CLKBUF factory.

name: ASM_MODEL_GENERATOR_YGR::create_models
comment: Stingray (YGR) model registration: ASM_CDB_NODE_MODEL_YGR, ASM_CHAIN_AND_CLA_MONITOR_YGR, ASM_FINP_CZAR_YGR, ASM_GID_MONITOR ...; atom-processing classes are NOT created here (see the search_for_* factories).

name: asmgx_search_for_arch_groups
comment: GX factory: one jump table, types 0x431..0x1236; 143 types bound to generic ASMGX_*_CGA_* classes whose process_atom maps a CGA atom parameter id (e.g. 0x40, 0x84, 0x43, 0x7e keyed by group type) to the mux value.

name: ASMGX_CENTRAL_CGA_ENUM::process_atom
comment: Generic CGA-enum writer: reads the atom's CGA param (ids 0x40 for group types 0x45c/0x658, 0x84 for 0x438, 0x43 for 0x477, 0x7e for 0x64e/0x64f) and passes the enum ordinal straight to ASM_ARCH_GROUP::mux_select(group, idx, ordinal).

name: ASM_PLL_M_HIGH_COUNTER::process_atom
comment: M counter high = (M+1)>>1 (uneven split); mux_select(PLL_M_HIGH_COUNTER, pll_index, value). Confirmed by 28 altpll specimens (m = high + low).

name: ASM_PLL_M_LOW_COUNTER::process_atom
comment: M counter low = M>>1.

name: ASM_PLL_N_HIGH_COUNTER::process_atom
comment: N high = (N+1)>>1; low group is the N>>1 sibling.

name: ASM_PLL_CHARGE_PUMP_CURRENT::process_atom
comment: Value = model getter (vtbl +0xf0) = netlist charge_pump_current_bits (28 of 28).

name: ASM_PLL_LOOP_FILTER_R::process_atom
comment: Value = model getter (vtbl +0x100); not an altpll parameter (value depends on M/N/bandwidth).

name: ASM_PLL_VCO_DIVIDE_BY_2::process_atom
comment: mux_select(vco_post_scale == 2); only values 1 and 2 legal.

name: ASM_PLL_OUTPUT_COUNTER_PHASE::process_atom
comment: Per counter (atom field +8); phase shift of altpll shows in OUTPUT_COUNTER_PRESET (c#_initial), not here (0 in all specimens).

name: ASM_PLL_OUTPUT_COUNTER_HIGH_COUNTER::process_atom
comment: Output counter high count = netlist c#_high; group gi = counter index.

name: ASM_PLL_MODEL_STINGRAY::process_atom
comment: Dispatch: pll_index (static) selects ASM_SINGLE_PLL_MODEL_STINGRAY in m_plls; each ASM_PLL_* class then writes its group for that index.

name: ASM_EAB_BLOCK_PORTS::write_block
comment: M9K port-list writer (asm_ram_extra.cpp): reads ASMDB_DIRT port lists (dirt type 0x3a); routing of block ports, not RAM mode bits.

name: ASM_MAC_BLOCK_PORTS::write_block
comment: MAC port-list writer (asm_mac_extra.cpp): dirt type 0x39 port list; routing only.

name: ASM_MAC_BLOCK_PORTS::find_mac_row_offset
comment: Row offset of a MAC within its column from the die location (4 probes).

name: ASMDB_ARCH_GROUP_STD::select
comment: select(site, value, streams): per mux_data entry i mux=paths[site][i]; bits=mux.select(value); arch_value==0 inverts every bit; next value = entry.next_mux.vcall_0x40(value), 0xfffffffb ends the chain.

name: ASMDB_ENCODED_MUX::select
comment: Bit k of the mux (m_mux_bits[k]) = (value >> k) & 1; value >= 2^nbits is an internal error (ENCODED_MUX::select). Pattern element i = value bit i.

name: ASMDB_MAPPED_ENCODED_MUX::select
comment: value = m_map_mux.vcall_0x40(value), then ASMDB_ENCODED_MUX::select.

name: ASMDB_ARCH_GROUP_DUMB::select
comment: One bit per site (m_bits[site]); value must be 0/1; bit = (value == 0) when arch_value == 0 else (value != 0).

name: asm_convert_db_to_asm_iost
comment: DEV_IO_STANDARD_ENUM -> IOST class via jump table at 0x3d9a68 (index std-4): 4,6 -> 0; 0xb -> 1; 0xc,0xd -> 2; 0x10,0x13,0x15,0x18 -> 3; 0x16,0x17 -> 4; 0x19-0x1f,0x2c-0x33,0x4b -> 5; 0x37,0x3b,0x60,0x66 -> 7; 0x40 -> 9; 0x44 -> 10; 0x46 -> 11; 0x45 -> 12; other listed -> internal error; 0x47-0x4f,0x51-0x53 -> family default (7 / 5 / 8). Family arg 0x3d YEAGER; output does not equal the IOST patterns measured on Stingray output pins (2.5 V -> 0, 1.2 V -> 2, SSTL-2 out -> 0): conversion path for Stingray not identified.

name: ASM_IO_SELECT_IOST::process_atom
comment: IOST value = mux_select(group, io_index, v): v = 3 for a reserved / unused pin (cut_io_util vcall 0x28 flag 3), 6 for a VREF pin, 8 for the differential companion, else asm_convert_db_to_asm_iost(std, base_family, 0) when atom bit 4 or 6 is set. Value 3 = unused (measured IOST 1100).

name: ASM_IO_USE_PCI_DIODE_CLAMP::process_atom
comment: PCI diode clamp bit = atom flag (byte at +8, bit 5, is_pci_io_enabled) via mux_select(group, io_index, flag); HIO pins reject the setting for non-clamp pads (internal error).
